messages.author: 1d22b88696fb889c
messages.subject: Shiny app exit processing
parts:
I see there are methods of invoking exit processing when a session ends (e.g. onSessionEnded), but I can't find a method for specifying exit processing with the *app* exits.

In my particular use case, I need to establish an SSH tunnel to a data source when the app starts, and tear it down when the app exits. Creating the tunnel is done in server.R, prior to the shinyServer() call (via a system() call that creates the tunnel, stores a control handle, and puts it in the background). But I can't figure out a point to specify the tear-down code when the app exits.

Any ideas?

Thanks,
Eric

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny app exit processing
parts:
Is this for a Shiny app that will be invoked from the R console (like from a package)? Or something that'll be served to a wider audience over Shiny Server?

In the former case, I'd write a wrapper function around runApp that does the cleanup in on.exit.

In the latter case... hmmmm... :-\
